urea.name: Urea
urea.description: Main source of quick-release Nitrogen (46% N) widely used in Indian agriculture.

dap.name: DAP (Di-Ammonium Phosphate)
dap.description: Premium phosphatic fertilizer providing 46% P2O5 and 18% N, ideal for basal application.

ssp.name: SSP (Single Super Phosphate)
ssp.description: Cost-effective phosphorus source (16% P2O5) with beneficial 11% Sulfur and 19% Calcium for oilseeds and pulses.

mop.name: MOP (Muriate of Potash)
mop.description: Primary potassium source (60% K2O) enhancing drought tolerance, pest resistance, and grain quality.

npk_10_26_26.name: NPK Complex (10-26-26)
npk_10_26_26.description: Balanced complex fertilizer for potassium and phosphorus loving crops like sugarcane, potato, and banana.

npk_12_32_16.name: NPK Complex (12-32-16)
npk_12_32_16.description: High phosphorus complex for cereal basal placement.

npk_19_19_19.name: NPK 19-19-19 (Water Soluble)
npk_19_19_19.description: 100% water-soluble foliar spray / fertigation fertilizer for quick nutrient uptake during active growth.

zinc_sulphate.name: Zinc Sulphate Heptahydrate (21% Zn)
zinc_sulphate.description: Essential micronutrient correcting Khaira disease in rice and white bud in maize.

gypsum.name: Agricultural Gypsum (CaSO4.2H2O)
gypsum.description: Reclaims sodic / alkaline soils (pH > 8.0) and supplies vital Calcium & Sulfur for oilseeds.

lime.name: Agricultural Lime (CaCO3)
lime.description: Neutralizes acidic soils (pH < 6.0) to release locked Phosphorus and beneficial soil microbes.

splits.timing: Apply at final land preparation / sowing

wheat.organic: Well decomposed FYM 8-10 tonnes/ha or Vermicompost 2.5 tonnes/ha at field preparation.
wheat.special_advisory: Apply 25 kg/ha Zinc Sulphate (21%) once every 2-3 years in Zn-deficient soils.

rice.organic: Incorporate Sesbania (Dhaincha) green manure 45 days before puddling or FYM 10 t/ha.
rice.special_advisory: Apply 25 kg/ha Zinc Sulphate (21%) at puddling to prevent Khaira disease. Avoid mixing zinc directly with DAP.

splits.timing: Band placement 5 cm below seed depth at sowing
30-35 days after sowing followed by earthing up

maize.organic: Apply 10 tonnes/ha FYM or 3 tonnes/ha Vermicompost 15 days before sowing.
maize.special_advisory: Maize is a heavy feeder. Side-dress nitrogen 8-10 cm away from plant rows.

splits.timing: Apply in furrows at sowing time

cotton.organic: FYM 8-10 t/ha + 250 kg/ha Neem cake to improve moisture retention and repel soil nematodes.
cotton.special_advisory: Foliar spray 1% MgSO4 + 1% 19-19-19 at peak flowering to prevent leaf reddening.

splits.timing: 90-120 days after planting during final earthing up

sugarcane.organic: Pressmud compost 10-15 tonnes/ha or FYM 20 tonnes/ha with trash mulching.
sugarcane.special_advisory: Avoid late nitrogen application after 150 days to prevent excess vegetative growth and low juice sucrose.

splits.timing: Apply basal dose 4-5 cm below seed depth

mustard.special_advisory: Apply 20-30 kg/ha Elemental Sulfur or 200 kg/ha Gypsum at basal to increase seed oil content by 2-3%.

splits.timing: Entire fertilizer placed 5 cm below seed at sowing

chickpea.organic: FYM 5 tonnes/ha + Rhizobium and Phosphate Solubilizing Bacteria (PSB) seed treatment (200g/10kg seed).
chickpea.special_advisory: Pulses fix their own atmospheric N; excessive nitrogen promotes vegetative growth at cost of pod set.

splits.timing: Entire fertilizer drilled below seed at sowing

soybean.organic: FYM 5-7.5 tonnes/ha + Bradyrhizobium japonicum and PSB seed inoculation.
soybean.special_advisory: Apply 20 kg/ha Sulfur through SSP or Gypsum to boost grain protein and oil content.

splits.timing: Apply at final land preparation / sowing

groundnut.special_advisory: Crucial: Top-dress Gypsum (200-400 kg/ha) at 40-45 DAS (pegging stage) to supply Calcium for pod shell hardening.

splits.timing: Furrow application before placing seed tubers
30-35 days after planting followed by immediate earthing up

potato.organic: Well rotten FYM 20-25 tonnes/ha or Vermicompost 5 tonnes/ha at field preparation.
potato.special_advisory: SOP (Sulphate of Potash) is preferred over MOP to prevent chloride toxicity and increase tuber starch.

tomato.organic: FYM 15-20 tonnes/ha + 250 kg/ha Neem cake at land preparation.
tomato.special_advisory: Foliar spray 0.5% Calcium Nitrate during fruit setting to prevent Blossom End Rot.

splits.timing: Broadcast and incorporate during final harrowing
45-50 days after transplanting. Stop nitrogen after 60 days.

onion.organic: FYM 15 tonnes/ha or Poultry manure 5 tonnes/ha at field preparation.
onion.special_advisory: Apply 30 kg/ha Sulfur to enhance onion pungency, bulb firmness, and storage quality.

splits.timing: Ring application 30 cm away from pseudo-stem
Ring application 45 cm away with earthing up

banana.organic: Apply 15-20 kg FYM + 500g Neem cake per plant pit at planting.
banana.special_advisory: Potassium is the chief driver of bunch weight and finger sweetness; do not skip late K applications.

jute.special_advisory: Avoid excess nitrogen which makes stems succulent and reduces fibre tensile strength.

tea.organic: Compost / Vermicompost 5-8 tonnes/ha once a year.
tea.special_advisory: Zinc Sulphate (1-2%) + Boric Acid (0.5%) foliar spray 4 times a year maintains young flush shoot vigor.

coffee.organic: Compost 5 tonnes/ha or cattle manure around drip circle.
coffee.special_advisory: Apply Dolomite (1-2 tonnes/ha) every 3 years if soil pH drops below 5.5.

default.organic: Well-rotted FYM 5-10 tonnes/ha or Vermicompost 2-3 tonnes/ha.
default.special_advisory: Conduct periodic soil tests to fine-tune nutrient doses based on local soil fertility.

disclaimer: This is a general guideline based on ICAR agronomic standards. Please get a soil test from your nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) / Soil Health Card laboratory and follow your State Agriculture Department recommendations.
